name: Verify the native third-spy capacity after a saved immediate or later Civic completion

steps.code: local s=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.ThirdSpyCivicStatus(); assert(s.stage=='CAPACITY_READY' and s.owned and s.capacity==3 and s.captured==2,'test-only native spy capacity did not reach three with both captives preserved'); return s.stage
